static_traits.name: Li Chen
static_traits.occupation: Full-time homemaker (caring for children at home)
static_traits.family_status: Married, Has two children and two pets, husband as the sole financial source
static_traits.social_status: The relationship with her husband is strained by insecurity; having some friends to confide in, but not yet disclosing specific marriage worries to friends
static_traits.medical_history: without significant physical illness; without similar problem history; without prior psychotherapy/counseling experience
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperativeness, capable of self-Reflection; emotionally Anxious and insecure; willing to try cognitive-behavioral strategies and accept Guidance

basic_info.main_problem: I keep worrying my husband resents me for having no income, and fear he will eventually leave me for it.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these thoughts began affecting my mental health, causing Anxiety and mood swings; I want to find a way to express feelings without triggering arguments, and learn to see things from a more balanced perspective.
growth_experiences: Stopping Work six months ago to become a full-time caregiver for Two children, feeling financial Increased stress; marked insecurity and worries began after this role change.
Recent argument with husband over finances, after which related Anxiety and negative thoughts worsened, triggered almost daily when talking about money or future plans.

core_beliefs: My worth depends on whether I contribute financially

special_situations.event: Discussing vacation budget and family finances with husband
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I bring no income, my partner will resent me and eventually leave me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: In conversations, hurries to explain or self-blame to seek reassurance, emotions escalate leading to arguments
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He will leave me; I am a burden

special_situations.event: The husband mentions financial stress or expresses worry about money
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the other is worrying about money, it must be blaming me for having no income
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Over-focuses on and speculates about the other person's thoughts, avoids or cuts off money topics to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He is blaming me, he is dissatisfied with me

special_situations.event: After stopping Work, when checking bills or thinking about having no income
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Having no financial contribution equals having no value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proves one's own worth by doubling investment in housework and parenting, while evaluating oneself harshly
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have no income so I have no value

special_situations.event: Recalling past arguments when discussing future plans (e.g. children's education, travel) with husband
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One unsuccessful communication means the relationship will always be bad
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Being defensive in advance or avoiding future topics, preventing conflict escalation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He has always been dissatisfied with me, we will have problems sooner or later

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be unconditionally accepted by her partner and affirmed for her family contributions, gaining safety and worth in the relationship
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected, blamed, or abandoned for not yet providing financial contribution
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of being accused by self-blaming in advance and worrying excessively
By avoiding money topics or controlling the conversation, reduces conflict and maintains superficial relationship safety

object_relations.self_representation: I am a burden who lacks value and may drag the family down
object_relations.object_representation: He is picky and may leave at any time, a judge

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor asks for concrete evidence of the 'husband resents me' belief or challenges its assumptions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worrying her feelings will be negated, thus tending to attribute negative intentions to her husband to maintain consistency of self-Interpretation
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: First Empathize with her worry of being negated, gentle tone, using feeling-validating expressions; then gently probing evidence and other possibilities with open-ended questions, avoiding confrontational correction.

manifestations: Though having friends to talk to, not yet confiding marriage insecurity and Fear to anyone
Feels isolated amid partner pressure and economic issues; believes 'I am a burden'
outcomes: Blocked communication with partner, more arguments, rising sense of Relationship estrangement

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-blame and labeling oneself 'I am a burden'
Overly cautious when talking about worries; fears triggering conflict and finds it hard to clearly express needs

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Still firmly believes 'my husband secretly resents me' without direct evidence
Attributing dissatisfaction and Fear about the relationship to the other's attitude and intentions

exception_events.target_problem: When discussing money or future plans with her husband, Li Chen usually falls into 'I am a burden, he will leave' thoughts with strong Anxiety, escalating communication into arguments.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Last week at a family dinner After meals, her husband explicitly thanked Li Chen for a wonderful dinner and affirmed her efforts in childcare and housework; Li Chen felt seen then, Anxiety markedly reduced, with no arguments or negative cycles.
exception_events.reason: Clues: the interaction featured mainly positive feedback (husband expressing gratitude and affirmation), not centered on money; Li Chen could notice and accept positive evidence, thus not yet carried away by Catastrophizing.

positive_force: The partner expresses gratitude and affirmation; positive evidence exists in the relationship
Strong motivation to seek help, positive attitude; willing to try CBT methods such as decatastrophizing
Able to recall and capture moments of being appreciated, with material to correct negative beliefs
Having some social support (friends to talk to)
Willing to improve communication and learn more effective communication strategies
negative_force: Marked cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, jumping to conclusions (mind reading, predicting the future), and overgeneralization
Self-worth overly dependent on financial contribution, forming all-or-nothing evaluation
Difficulty regulating emotions, easily escalated when talking about money / the future
Communication easily moves toward a vicious cycle of blame - defense - quarreling
Insufficient use of external support (hiding true worries from friends)

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Anxiety and Catastrophizing when talking about money or future plans
antecedent: Discussing the budget or family finances with her husband
Conversations involving future plans like travel, children's education
target_behavior.core_reason: Tying personal worth to financial contribution, with strong Fear of Being rejected / abandoned
target_behavior.function: Relieving uncertainty and Anxiety through Anticipating worst outcomes and seeking immediate certainty (short-term self-soothing / control)
target_behavior.consequence: Triggering arguments, Relationship tension, reduced focus on daily housework and childcare, continuously intensifying Anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: Emotional escalation when communicating with partner (prone to arguments)
antecedent: When expressing worries, lacks an effective emotion-regulation and communication framework
When the other party mentions financial pressure or budget limits
target_behavior.core_reason: Highly sensitive to rejection; personalizes the other person's stress as blame toward herself
target_behavior.function: Raises emotional intensity to prompt the other to take a stance or give reassurance, seeking a sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Broken communication, escalated conflict, further reinforcing the 'relationship unsafe' negative cycle
